verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents Automations and scheduled tasks that run prompts automatically on recurring schedules (e.g. "run the tests every weekday at 9"), plus a personal webhook that notifies users when a chat response is ready. These are time-based triggers and one fixed event notification, not user-defined event→action rules. Python Functions and Filters could be used to build custom event handling, but only as code-level workarounds. Missing for 10: a user-configurable rule engine with event-based triggers (e.g. on new file, message, or external event), configurable actions beyond scheduled prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
